simple.prompt: She ___ a senior software consultant at an international firm.
simple.explanation: Subject 'She' (orang ketiga tunggal) berpasangan dengan to be 'is'.

simple.prompt: The team members ___ ready for the product demonstration.
simple.explanation: 'The team members' adalah subject jamak (plural/they), sehingga memakai to be 'are'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat deklaratif menggunakan to be yang tepat.
simple.targetSentence: I am responsible for customer support.
simple.explanation: Subject 'I' berpasangan dengan 'am', diikuti complement sifat 'responsible for customer support'.

simple.prompt: The weather in this coastal town ___ very pleasant in April.
simple.explanation: 'The weather' adalah uncountable noun (kata benda tak terhitung/tunggal), sehingga memakai 'is'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya sederhana menggunakan to be.
simple.targetSentence: Are you available for a quick meeting?
simple.explanation: Kalimat tanya untuk 'you': To be (Are) + Subject (you) + Adjective (available) + Prepositional phrase.

simple.prompt: Both my brother and my sister ___ working remotely today.
simple.explanation: Subjek majemuk yang dihubungkan dengan 'and' bernilai jamak (plural/they), jadi gunakan 'are'.
hints: Ada dua orang: brother dan sister.
Dua subjek digabung dengan 'and' bernilai jamak.

simple.targetSentence: This document is not the final version.
simple.explanation: Pola negatif: Subject (This document) + is + not + Noun phrase complement (the final version).

simple.prompt: I ___ excited to join the international workshop next week.
simple.explanation: Subjek 'I' selalu berpasangan dengan to be Present Simple 'am'.

simple.prompt: The printed brochures ___ still on the reception counter.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'The printed brochures' berpasangan dengan 'are'.

simple.prompt: Our company's headquarters ___ located near the central train station.
simple.explanation: 'Headquarters' di sini merujuk pada satu gedung/kantor pusat perusahaan, sehingga memakai 'is'.

simple.prompt: ___ your colleagues ready for the client walkthrough?
simple.explanation: 'Your colleagues' adalah subjek jamak sehingga pertanyaan memakai 'Are'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog telepon singkat menggunakan to be yang benar.
dialogue: Is Mr. Hendra available right now?
I'm sorry, he ___ in a board meeting until three.

simple.prompt: This digital thermometer ___ not accurate when the battery is low.
simple.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'This digital thermometer' memakai bentuk negatif 'is not'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penulisan singkatan (contraction) to be pada kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: Your keys are on the desk, and my wallet am in the bag.
options: Your keys are on the desk, and my wallet is in the bag.
Your keys is on the desk, and my wallet is in the bag.
Your keys are on the desk, and my wallet are in the bag.
simple.explanation: 'My wallet' setara dengan 'it' sehingga memakai 'is', bukan 'am'.

simple.prompt: Both laptops and tablets ___ discounted during the year-end sale.
simple.explanation: Subjek majemuk dengan 'and' ('Both laptops and tablets') bersifat jamak, sehingga memakai 'are'.
hints: Dua benda dihubungkan 'and' menjadi subjek jamak.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya sederhana dengan to be dan kata sifat.
simple.targetSentence: Are the conference rooms clean and bright?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan to be membalik 'Are' ke posisi sebelum subjek jamak 'the conference rooms'.
hints: Susun subjek 'the conference rooms' sebelum 'clean and bright'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif to be dengan subjek tunggal.
simple.targetSentence: The wireless microphone is not working properly.
simple.explanation: Subject (The wireless microphone) + is not + working properly.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di resepsionis kantor dengan to be yang sesuai.
dialogue: Excuse me, ___ Mr. Rahman in his office right now?
Yes, he is. Please have a seat for a moment.
intermediate.explanation: 'Mr. Rahman' adalah orang ketiga tunggal (he), sehingga pertanyaan memakai 'Is'.

intermediate.prompt: Neither the manager nor the supervisors ___ satisfied with the initial draft.
intermediate.explanation: Pada pola 'neither... nor...', to be menyesuaikan subjek terdekat yaitu 'the supervisors' (jamak), sehingga memakai 'are'.
hints: Perhatikan subjek yang paling dekat dengan to be ('supervisors').

intermediate.prompt: Neither the supervisors nor the manager ___ present at the hearing.
intermediate.explanation: Subjek terdekat dengan to be adalah 'the manager' (tunggal), maka to be yang tepat adalah 'is'.
hints: Subjek terdekat di sini adalah 'the manager' (tunggal).

intermediate.prompt: Susun respon tanya jawab singkat dengan to be.
intermediate.targetSentence: No they are not in the conference room.
intermediate.explanation: Respon negatif: No + subject pronoun (they) + are + not + prepositional phrase.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih jawaban singkat yang gramatikal dan alami.
dialogue: Are all project files updated on the shared drive?
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban singkat positif tidak boleh disingkat dengan apostrof (tidak boleh 'Yes, they're'). Harus lengkap: 'Yes, they are.'

intermediate.prompt: The committee ___ unanimous in its historic verdict.
intermediate.explanation: Collective noun 'committee' yang bertindak sebagai satu kesatuan utuh (terlihat dari pronoun 'its') memakai to be tunggal 'is'.
hints: Gunakan 'is' untuk collective noun sebagai satu entitas.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya inversi dengan kata tanya Wh-.
intermediate.targetSentence: Why are the server logs unavailable today?
intermediate.explanation: Wh-word (Why) + to be (are) + Subject (the server logs) + Adjective complement (unavailable) + Time (today).

intermediate.prompt: Everyone in both project teams ___ required to complete the safety orientation.
intermediate.explanation: Indefinite pronoun 'Everyone' selalu dianggap tunggal secara gramatikal dan memakai 'is'.
hints: 'Everyone' termasuk kata ganti tak tentu tunggal.
Jangan terkecoh oleh kata jamak 'teams' setelah 'in'.

intermediate.prompt: Fifty dollars ___ a fair price for that ergonomic keyboard.
intermediate.explanation: Jumlah uang, waktu, atau jarak sebagai satu kesatuan nilai memakai verb tunggal 'is'.
hints: Nilai uang dihitung sebagai satu jumlah total.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang situasi kemarin menggunakan bentuk lampau to be.
dialogue: Why was the corridor dark yesterday evening?
Several ceiling lights ___ out of order, so we replaced them.
intermediate.explanation: Subjek jamak 'Several ceiling lights' pada waktu lampau ('yesterday evening') memakai 'were'.

intermediate.prompt: Either the intern or the two coordinators ___ going to greet the guests.
intermediate.explanation: Dengan konstruksi 'Either A or B', verb mengikuti subjek yang paling dekat ('the two coordinators' = jamak), jadi 'are'.
hints: Periksa subjek yang paling dekat dengan posisi to be.

intermediate.prompt: Neither the coordinators nor the intern ___ available at noon.
intermediate.explanation: Pada pola 'Neither A nor B', verb menyesuaikan subjek terdekat ('the intern' = tunggal), jadi 'is'.
hints: Subjek terdekat dengan verb adalah 'the intern'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan jawaban singkat (short answer) yang kurang tepat berikut ini.
intermediate.draft: Are you the new logistics supervisor? — Yes, I'm.
options: Are you the new logistics supervisor? — Yes, I am.
Are you the new logistics supervisor? — Yes, I are.
Are you the new logistics supervisor? — Yes, you are.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam jawaban singkat positif ('Yes, I am'), to be tidak boleh disingkat menjadi 'I'm'.
hints: Jawaban singkat positif tidak memakai singkatan di akhir kalimat.

intermediate.prompt: Mathematics ___ my favorite subject during undergraduate studies.
intermediate.explanation: Nama cabang ilmu berakhiran -s seperti 'Mathematics', 'Economics', dan 'Physics' adalah tunggal, memakai 'is'.
hints: Ini adalah nama satu bidang studi.

intermediate.prompt: Where ___ your parents traveling when the storm started?
intermediate.explanation: 'Your parents' jamak dan konteksnya lampau ('when the storm started'), sehingga memakai 'were'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan subjek tak tentu tunggal 'Nobody'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Nobody is allowed inside the server room without clearance.
intermediate.explanation: Indefinite pronoun 'Nobody' selalu menggunakan to be tunggal 'is'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat lampau dengan 'weren't' yang tepat.
intermediate.targetSentence: The quarterly figures weren't as strong as expected.
intermediate.explanation: Subjek jamak lampau 'The quarterly figures' memakai 'weren't'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki subject-verb agreement pada kalimat yang disisipi frasa preposisi.
complex.draft: The primary cause of these complex issues are lack of communication.
options: The primary cause of these complex issues is lack of communication.
The primary cause of these complex issues are the lack of communication.
The primary causes of this complex issue is lack of communication.
complex.explanation: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'The primary cause' (tunggal), bukan 'issues'. Maka to be yang benar adalah 'is'.
hints: Abaikan frasa pengganggu 'of these complex issues'.

complex.prompt: A number of qualified candidates ___ being interviewed this afternoon.
complex.explanation: Frasa 'A number of' berarti 'sejumlah/banyak' dan selalu diikuti noun jamak serta kata kerja jamak 'are'.
hints: 'A number of' berbeda dengan 'The number of'.

complex.prompt: Sebaliknya: 'The number of applicants ___ increased substantially this quarter.'
complex.explanation: Frasa 'The number of' mengacu pada angka/jumlah spesifik (entitas tunggal), sehingga memakai 'has' atau 'is'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan to be pada konstruksi sematan.
complex.draft: One of the most experienced directors are leading the new taskforce.
options: One of the most experienced directors is leading the new taskforce.
One of the most experienced directors are being leading the new taskforce.
One of the most experienced director is leading the new taskforce.
complex.explanation: Pola 'One of + plural noun' memiliki subjek inti 'One' (satu orang/tunggal), sehingga membutuhkan to be 'is'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal dengan klausa relatif dan to be.
complex.targetSentence: The data that is collected remains confidential.
complex.explanation: 'Data' di konteks modern teknologi sering diperlakukan sebagai singular mass noun: 'that is collected'.
hints: Gunakan klausa relatif 'that is collected' sebelum verb utama 'remains'.

complex.prompt: Pilih bentuk to be yang sesuai dengan subjek semu (dummy subject).
dialogue: What is the reason for this expenditure?
It ___ the additional consulting fees that caused the surge.
complex.explanation: Pada cleft sentence yang diawali dummy 'It', to be SELALU berbentuk tunggal ('It is' atau 'It was'), meskipun kata yang ditekankan jamak.
hints: Pada konstruksi 'It is/was...', subjek tata bahasa adalah 'It'.
'It' selalu berpasangan dengan to be tunggal.

complex.prompt: Koreksi to be pada kalimat dengan frasa 'as well as'.
complex.draft: The CEO, as well as her senior executives, are attending the summit.
options: The CEO, as well as her senior executives, is attending the summit.
The CEO, as well as her senior executives, are being attending the summit.
The CEO as well as her senior executives were both attending the summit.
complex.explanation: Frasa sisipan seperti 'as well as', 'together with', atau 'along with' tidak mengubah jumlah subjek utama ('The CEO' = tunggal), sehingga tetap memakai 'is'.
hints: Frasa 'as well as' adalah keterangan tambahan, bukan penggabung jamak 'and'.

complex.prompt: The CEO, together with three senior vice presidents, ___ attending the summit in Zurich.
complex.explanation: Frasa pengiring seperti 'together with', 'as well as', dan 'along with' tidak mengubah status tunggal subjek inti 'The CEO'.
hints: Cari subjek utama sebelum koma pertama.

complex.prompt: Every single employee and contractor ___ briefed on data privacy before receiving an ID badge.
complex.explanation: Ketika dua kata benda tunggal diawali kata 'Every' atau 'Each', konstruksinya selalu dihitung tunggal ('was').
hints: Lihat penentu 'Every single...' di depan subjek.
'Every' membuat seluruh frasa subjek bernilai tunggal.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan agreement pada kalimat inversi tempat (locative inversion) berikut.
complex.draft: Behind the historic library is two quiet botanical courtyards.
options: Behind the historic library are two quiet botanical courtyards.
Behind the historic library am two quiet botanical courtyards.
Two quiet botanical courtyards is behind the historic library.
complex.explanation: Pada inversi lokasi, subjek sebenarnya terletak setelah verb ('two quiet botanical courtyards' = jamak), jadi gunakan 'are'.
hints: Temukan subjek yang berada setelah kata kerja.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi diskusi kebijakan SDM mengenai penggunaan 'the number of' vs 'a number of'.
dialogue: Why are extra chairs needed in Hall B?
Because the number of confirmed delegates ___ higher than our initial estimate.
complex.explanation: Frasa 'The number of + plural noun' mengacu pada satu angka statistik total, sehingga selalu memakai verb tunggal 'is'.
hints: Bedakan 'a number of' (banyak = jamak) dan 'the number of' (jumlah angka = tunggal).
Subjek intinya adalah kata tunggal 'the number'.

complex.prompt: Sebaliknya: 'A growing number of remote workers ___ opting for coworking passes this year.'
complex.explanation: Frasa 'A (growing) number of + plural noun' bermakna 'sejumlah/banyak...', sehingga memakai verb jamak 'are'.

complex.prompt: Two-thirds of the archived footage ___ already digitized, while the remaining clips are queued.
complex.explanation: Dengan pecahan ('Two-thirds of...'), verb mengikuti kata benda setelah 'of'. 'Footage' adalah uncountable noun sehingga memakai 'is'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan kesesuaian to be pada kalimat definisi akademis ber-relative clause berikut.
complex.draft: She is one of the researchers who is developing the new vaccine protocol.
options: She is one of the researchers who are developing the new vaccine protocol.
She are one of the researchers who is developing the new vaccine protocol.
She is one of the researcher who are developing the new vaccine protocol.
complex.explanation: Dalam pola 'one of the [plural noun] who...', relative pronoun 'who' merujuk ke kata jamak 'the researchers', sehingga memakai 'are'.
hints: Siapa yang dirujuk oleh 'who' dalam kalimat ini?

complex.prompt: What worries regional investors most ___ unpredictable regulatory changes.
complex.explanation: Subjek berupa klausa nominal 'What worries regional investors most' (satu hal utama yang mengkhawatirkan) selalu memakai verb tunggal 'is' pada ragam baku.
hints: Perlakukan klausa nominal 'What worries...' sebagai satu kesatuan tunggal.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal dengan subjek gerund dan linking verb to be.
complex.targetSentence: Managing cross-cultural teams is essential for global growth.
complex.explanation: Frasa gerund 'Managing cross-cultural teams' selalu diperlakukan sebagai subjek tunggal dengan to be 'is'.
hints: Mulai dengan subjek frasa gerund 'Managing cross-cultural teams'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan kata benda kolektif yang merujuk pada anggotanya (British/formal usage).
complex.targetSentence: The committee are divided over the proposed budget cuts.
complex.explanation: Jika anggota komite bertindak atau berpendapat berbeda-beda ('divided'), verb jamak 'are' menekankan tiap individu.
hints: Lengkapi frasa 'over the proposed budget cuts'.
